Rule.name: Rule - Workgroup Empty Or Inactive Membership Notification Rule
Rule.Description: Finds workgroups that have no members or no active identity members and emails the report to an admin workgroup.

Argument.name: log
Argument.Description: The log object associated with the SailPointContext.

Argument.name: context
Argument.Description: A sailpoint.api.SailPointContext object that can be used to query the database.

Argument.name: arguments
Argument.Description: Map containing arguments such as adminWorkgroupName and emailTemplateName.
